description: main window + capture overlay. The overlay webview MUST be listed: it subscribes to the warm-window 'capture-refresh' event, and core:event listen is ACL-gated per window label — an unlisted window's JS listeners are silently denied (root cause of the v0.4.4–v0.4.8 'dead overlay': the webview was never dead, it was deaf; app custom commands are ungated, which is why get_captured_image kept working)
